title: Evaluation normalization of the specified native small-site Hom comparison
statement: For any scheme Y, prime l and normalized native Hom comparison H, let E be the specified small-site-to-native equivalence [def-sf-native-frobenius-model-data], h its fixed Hom comparison [def-sf-native-frobenius-hom-comparison], and e the counit identifying the native section modules of E with small-site restriction. For every pair of ordinary small-site modules M,N, pro-etale object V, native section z of E(Hom(M,N)) over V and native section x of E(M) over V, applying e_N to native evaluation of h(z) on x equals evaluation on e_M(x) of the local map e_Hom(z) at the identity slice lifted by AsSmall.up.

source.place: Internal-Hom comparison and naturality of evaluation paragraph; ordinary small-site restriction and Frobenius translation.

proof.text: For an abstract equivalence, expand the inverse Hom comparison and apply the forward functor. Counit naturality and the triangle identity cancel the unit and Hom-isomorphism inverse. Precomposing an inverse-image map contributes precisely the counit at its source.

source.place: Internal-Hom comparison and naturality of evaluation paragraph; ordinary small-site restriction and Frobenius translation.

proof.text: Specialize to the native section equivalence and the unlifted small-site Hom comparison. The ordinary Hom bifunctor acts by precomposition with e_M and postcomposition with e_N inverse. Evaluate at the identity slice, apply the evaluation normalization field of H, and cancel e_N inverse. The small-site Hom comparison evaluates on the lifted identity arrow by its definition.

theorem comparison_evaluation (Y : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (H : AdicModuleHomComparisonCore l Y) (M N : Modules (ring Y l))
    (V : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (z : ((equivalence Y l).functor.obj
      (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := ring Y l) M N)).X.obj.obj V)
    (x : ((equivalence Y l).functor.obj M).X.obj.obj V) :
    ((sectionCounit Y l).hom.app N).val.app V
      (adicComparisonEval ((equivalence Y l).functor.obj M) ((equivalence Y l).functor.obj N)
        V ((homComparison Y l H M N).hom.hom.hom.app V z) x) =
      ((((sectionCounit Y l).hom.app (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := ring Y l) M N)).val.app V z).app
        (op (Over.mk (AsSmall.up.map (𝟙 V.unop)))))
          (((sectionCounit Y l).hom.app M).val.app V x)
